description: Stable Image Services, a comprehensive suite of thirteen specialized image editing tools from Stability AI designed to accelerate professional creative workflows.  Stable Image Services enables granular control over image editing with a range of tools designed to work with your creative process, allowing you to take a single concept from ideation to finished product with precision and flexibility. The Stable Image Style Guide service extracts stylistic elements from an input image (control image) and uses it to guide the creation of an output image based on the prompt. The result is a new image in the same style as the control image.
